description: Cessna 185A Skywagon LV-HUA 'Don Luis Vernet' in which Miguel Fitzgerald made his solo flight to Port Stanley on 8 September 1964 to plant an Argentine flag; displayed inside the museum since its 2014 opening (passed through Morón for preparation in April 2014).
